curriculum_name: Full-Stack Software Engineering – Jeff Hutting Edition
audience: Self-directed adult learner transitioning toward professional software engineering
global_objectives: Develop competency in modern full-stack web development
Build and deploy real applications with increasing autonomy
Gain confidence navigating real codebases and debugging problems
Learn core computer science concepts relevant to practical engineering
Create a professional portfolio demonstrating real technical capability
Prepare effectively for technical interviews and professional collaboration

prerequisites: Willingness to learn and persist through challenges
Access to a computer with internet
Time commitment of 10–15 hours per week
Growth mindset and willingness to ask for help
pedagogy_principles: Small, frequent exercises over giant projects
Use realistic but not overwhelming examples
